email_metadata.subject: Re: RFx Corrugated Packaging Rates FY26

raw_email_body:
Dear Procurement Team,

Please find our rates for the upcoming contract:
- All 5-ply cartons @ Rs 44/kg base.
- All 3-ply universal cartons @ Rs 39/kg base.
- Die-cut mailers @ Rs 56/kg base.
- Edge protectors @ Rs 14.50/pc.
- Honeycomb buffer sheets @ Rs 82.00/pc.
- Reinforced kraft tape @ Rs 39.50/roll.

Note: Freight is 4% extra on total invoice. Delivery within 4 days across all plant locations. Tooling at actual cost.

Regards,
Balaji Packaging Team
